description: This script contains functions for managing boot configuration and preparing the system for upgrade on an ASRock device, involving manipulation of MTD partitions and UBI volumes.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies the boot configuration MTD partition based on the passed parameter ('bootcheck' or 'sysupgrade').

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by setting the upgrade flag and removing certain UBI volumes.
